# birdscanR

BirdscanR is an R package to extract data from Birdscan MR1 SQL
vertical-looking radar databases, filter, and process them to Migration
Traffic Rates (# objects per hour and km) or density (# objects per km3)
of, for example birds, and insects. Object classifications in the
‘Birdscan MR1’ databases are based on the dataset of [Haest et
al. (2021)](https://doi.org10.5281/zenodo.5734960). Migration Traffic
Rates and densities can be calculated separately for different height
bins (with a height resolution of choice) as well as over time periods
of choice (e.g., 1/2 hour, 1 hour, 1 day, day/night, the full time
period of observation, and anything in between). Two plotting functions
are also included to explore the data in the SQL databases and the
resulting Migration Traffic Rate results. For details on the Migration
Traffic Rate calculation procedures, see [Schmid et
al. (2019)](https://doi.org/10.1111/ecog.04025).

To get started, see:

- [Get
  started](https://birdscancommunity.github.io/birdscanR/articles/birdscanR.html):
  an introduction to the package’s main functionalities.
- [Function
  reference](https://birdscancommunity.github.io/birdscanR/reference/index.html):
  overview of all functions.
- [More HowTo
  Guides](https://birdscancommunity.github.io/birdscanR/articles/):
  Additional guides to get you up and going with the different
  functionality of the package.

## Installation

Install the latest released version from CRAN:

``` r

install.packages("birdscanR")
```

Or the development version from
[GitHub](https://github.com/BirdScanCommunity/birdscanR):

``` r

# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("BirdScanCommunity/birdscanR")
```

# Package index

## Read SQL database functions

- [`QUERY()`](https://birdscancommunity.github.io/birdscanR/reference/QUERY.md)
  : Query 'SQL' database
- [`dbConnectBirdscanSQL()`](https://birdscancommunity.github.io/birdscanR/reference/dbConnectBirdscanSQL.md)
  : Connect to a Birdscan SQL database
- [`extractDbData()`](https://birdscancommunity.github.io/birdscanR/reference/extractDbData.md)
  : Extract DB Data
- [`getBatClassification()`](https://birdscancommunity.github.io/birdscanR/reference/getBatClassification.md)
  : Get a BirdScan 'batClassification' table
- [`getCollectionTable()`](https://birdscancommunity.github.io/birdscanR/reference/getCollectionTable.md)
  : Get BirdScan collection table
- [`getEchoFeatures()`](https://birdscancommunity.github.io/birdscanR/reference/getEchoFeatures.md)
  : Get BirdScan echo features
- [`getEchoValidationTable()`](https://birdscancommunity.github.io/birdscanR/reference/getEchoValidationTable.md)
  : Get a BirdScan echo validation table
- [`getProtocolTable()`](https://birdscancommunity.github.io/birdscanR/reference/getProtocolTable.md)
  : Get BirdScan protocol table
- [`getRadarTable()`](https://birdscancommunity.github.io/birdscanR/reference/getRadarTable.md)
  : Get a BirdScan radar table
- [`getRfClassification()`](https://birdscancommunity.github.io/birdscanR/reference/getRfClassification.md)
  : Get a BirdScan 'rfClassification' table
- [`getSiteTable()`](https://birdscancommunity.github.io/birdscanR/reference/getSiteTable.md)
  : Get BirdScan site table
- [`getTimeBinsTable()`](https://birdscancommunity.github.io/birdscanR/reference/getTimeBinsTable.md)
  : Get BirdScan time bins table
- [`getVisibilityTable()`](https://birdscancommunity.github.io/birdscanR/reference/getVisibilityTable.md)
  : Get BirdScan visibility table

## Read and write file functions

- [`getManualVisibilityTable()`](https://birdscancommunity.github.io/birdscanR/reference/getManualVisibilityTable.md)
  : Get manual visibility table
- [`compileData()`](https://birdscancommunity.github.io/birdscanR/reference/compileData.md)
  : compileData
- [`saveMTR()`](https://birdscancommunity.github.io/birdscanR/reference/saveMTR.md)
  : saveMTR
- [`savePlotToFile()`](https://birdscancommunity.github.io/birdscanR/reference/savePlotToFile.md)
  : savePlotToFile

## Filter and manipulation functions

- [`filterData()`](https://birdscancommunity.github.io/birdscanR/reference/filterData.md)
  : filterData
- [`filterEchoData()`](https://birdscancommunity.github.io/birdscanR/reference/filterEchoData.md)
  : filterEchoData
- [`filterProtocolData()`](https://birdscancommunity.github.io/birdscanR/reference/filterProtocolData.md)
  : filterProtocolData
- [`addDayNightInfoPerEcho()`](https://birdscancommunity.github.io/birdscanR/reference/addDayNightInfoPerEcho.md)
  : addDayNightInfoPerEcho
- [`computeDensity()`](https://birdscancommunity.github.io/birdscanR/reference/computeDensity.md)
  : computeDensity
- [`computeMTR()`](https://birdscancommunity.github.io/birdscanR/reference/computeMTR.md)
  : computeMTR
- [`convertTimeZone()`](https://birdscancommunity.github.io/birdscanR/reference/convertTimeZone.md)
  : Converts timestamps from radar time zone to an user-defined time
  zone
- [`createVPTS()`](https://birdscancommunity.github.io/birdscanR/reference/createVPTS.md)
  : createVPTS
- [`filterSpeedFeature37()`](https://birdscancommunity.github.io/birdscanR/reference/filterSpeedFeature37.md)
  : Filter outliers in Speed feature (collection.feature37)
- [`mergeVisibilityAndManualBlindTimes()`](https://birdscancommunity.github.io/birdscanR/reference/mergeVisibilityAndManualBlindTimes.md)
  : mergeVisibilityAndManualBlindTimes
- [`reclassToBats()`](https://birdscancommunity.github.io/birdscanR/reference/reclassToBats.md)
  : integrate bat classification
- [`twilight()`](https://birdscancommunity.github.io/birdscanR/reference/twilight.md)
  : Get the nautical, civil, and solar dawn and dusk for a given
  timerange and locations.

## Plot functions

- [`createTimeRangeForPlot()`](https://birdscancommunity.github.io/birdscanR/reference/createTimeRangeForPlot.md)
  : Create Time Range for Plot
- [`plotExploration()`](https://birdscancommunity.github.io/birdscanR/reference/plotExploration.md)
  : plotExploration
- [`plotLongitudinalMTR()`](https://birdscancommunity.github.io/birdscanR/reference/plotLongitudinalMTR.md)
  : plotLongitudinalMTR

## Sample data

- [`CH_Sempach_2024_SEP24_25_DataExtract`](https://birdscancommunity.github.io/birdscanR/reference/CH_Sempach_2024_SEP24_25_DataExtract.md)
  : Example Birdscan MR1 data extract from Sempach, Switzerland
- [`classAbbreviations`](https://birdscancommunity.github.io/birdscanR/reference/classAbbreviations.md)
  : Default class abbreviations table of the birdscanR package
- [`loadManualBlindTimes()`](https://birdscancommunity.github.io/birdscanR/reference/loadManualBlindTimes.md)
  : loadManualBlindTimes
- [`manualBlindTimes`](https://birdscancommunity.github.io/birdscanR/reference/manualBlindTimes.md)
  : Example file on how to include manual blind times for your 'Birdscan
  MR1' database.

# Articles

### All vignettes

- [Introduction to
  birdscanR](https://birdscancommunity.github.io/birdscanR/articles/birdscanR.md):

  Which functions do I need to call to calculate migration traffic rates
  from data stored in an SQL Birdscan database? This vignette describes
  the main workflow to do so.

- [Guide to extracting specific tables from a Birdscan MR1 SQL
  database](https://birdscancommunity.github.io/birdscanR/articles/extractingSingleTableFromTheSqlDatabase.md):

  Which functions do I need to call to get the data from specific tables
  from the Birdscsan MR1 SQL database? This vignette describes the main
  workflow to do so.
